info.title: AI-Powered Bug Tracking System
info.description:
REST API for the AI-Powered Bug Tracking System: bug lifecycle management plus an integrated triage pipeline (duplicate detection, severity classification, developer assignment). All business routes are under `/api/v1`.

Errors always have the shape `{code, message, details}`.
